message.zh: 26.4.9 是重要功能更新：新增独立三步规划计算器和快捷设置，重做任务筛选与动作队列时间，并修复加工茶、库存摘要、生产控件等问题。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.9 is an important feature update. It adds the standalone three-step planner and quick settings, redesigns task filters and action-queue timing, and fixes Processing Tea, inventory summaries, production controls, and more. Update on Greasy Fork.
